concerns.text: FR-001 and spec Edge Cases mandate that noise injection MUST 'replace' a proportion of edges (removing existing edges before adding new ones) to maintain graph density. T011b and T011c describe 'replacing' but T011a-1 explicitly defines the transformation as 'adding new random edges' and T011b's selection algorithm says 'excluding... existing edges' (implying addition). This semantic conflation of 'addition' vs 'replacement' violates the FR-001 constraint that the graph density must remain constant for valid stress testing.

SC-004 requires identifying the inflection point where accuracy drops below 95% of the *baseline* (clean data). T027b explicitly calculates this threshold against `noisy_baseline_results.csv` (the noisy dataset). This silently relaxes the acceptance criterion by measuring degradation against a perturbed baseline rather than the ground-truth baseline, invalidating the scientific claim of the threshold analysis.

Plan Technical Context and Constitution Principle VI mandate a ~7GB RAM limit on GitHub Actions. T005 hardcodes a download of `Llama-2-7B-Chat-GGUF.Q4_K_M.gguf` (typically >7GB) and only checks file size *after* download logic begins. This violates the computational efficiency constraint by risking an OOM failure before the check can halt execution, effectively weakening the 'CPU-only/7GB' requirement.

The spec and plan define the goal as measuring and comparing strategies, not engineering optimization. T030 mandates reducing latency by 'at least 15%' in `full.py`. This introduces a performance optimization goal not present in the FRs/SCs, constituting scope creep that weakens the research focus on measurement and comparison.

FR-003 requires logging the 'specific evidence threshold value used for that run'. T017 logs this to an 'execution log', but T019a defines the output schema for `lazy_results.csv` without including the `evidence_threshold` column. This silently drops the acceptance criterion that the threshold must be available for the statistical analysis (SC-002/SC-003), as the primary results file will lack this data.
